name: Owl. Calm Home
description: Owl.'s calm home page for any Chromium browser: a big clock, the line of your day, your bookmarks bar, the weather, the pages you left, and day, week and month reports of where your time goes. Everything stays on this computer.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src https://api.open-meteo.com https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'
